about_the_game:
"I'm Pregnant at 16: Episode 2" is the direct continuation of a visual novel about difficult choices and their consequences.

The story continues. The heroine returns, but now her life becomes even more complicated and profound. New events, new characters, and new branching paths lead to different outcomes.

In the second episode, you will help Lida face new challenges: understand herself, repair (or destroy) relationships with those around her, and make decisions that will determine not only her own future but also the fates of other characters.

Features of the second episode:

  • Story continuation: The plot picks up immediately after the events of the first episode and develops in new directions, preserving and enhancing the original atmosphere.

  • New and familiar characters: Already familiar faces will reveal unexpected sides. New bright and complex personalities will appear, changing the course of events.

  • More choices, more consequences: A branching storyline with multiple endings. Every choice matters.

  • Even more memes, references, achievements, and a bit of cringe.

Immerse yourself in a realistic story that’s at times harsh, at times touching — the story of a 16-year-old pregnant girl.

Experience what it’s like to be pregnant at 16.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains minimal textual descriptions of intimate relationships without detailed scenes. It includes occasional strong language and mentions teenage pregnancy, including discussions about the possibility of abortion.
